parameters.name: input_dir
parameters.description: Directory containing the extraction results to classify.
parameters.help_text: Directory containing the extraction results to classify.

parameters.name: output_dir
parameters.description: Directory where output files will be saved.
parameters.help_text: Directory where output files will be saved.

parameters.name: tmp_dir
parameters.description: Directory for temporary files, and where the ROInet network files are unpacked. Must be writable.
parameters.help_text: Directory for temporary files, and where the ROInet network files are unpacked. Must be writable.

parameters.name: soma_classifier_path
parameters.description: Path to the soma classifier ONNX model.
parameters.help_text: Path to the soma classifier ONNX model.

parameters.name: dendrite_classifier_path
parameters.description: Path to the dendrite classifier ONNX model.
parameters.help_text: Path to the dendrite classifier ONNX model.

parameters.name: model_name
parameters.description: Identifier recorded in processing.json. Defaults to the directory name of soma_classifier_path.
parameters.help_text: Identifier recorded in processing.json. Defaults to the directory name of soma_classifier_path.

parameters.name: border_size
parameters.description: Distance in pixels from the field-of-view border for an ROI to be classified as a border ROI.
parameters.help_text: Distance in pixels from the field-of-view border for an ROI to be classified as a border ROI.

parameters.name: um_per_pixel
parameters.description: Micrometres per pixel, used to scale the ROI images fed to ROInet. Read from the acquisition metadata when omitted; supply it explicitly only when the metadata does not carry it, because an incorrect value silently changes every classification.
parameters.help_text: Micrometres per pixel, used to scale the ROI images fed to ROInet. Read from the acquisition metadata when omitted; supply it explicitly only when the metadata does not carry it, because an incorrect value silently changes every classification.

parameters.name: roinet_dir
parameters.description: Directory holding a pre-staged ROInet.zip. When set, the network files are loaded from there instead of being downloaded, which is required inside the pipeline where every task otherwise re-fetches ~105 MB from osf.io.
parameters.help_text: Directory holding a pre-staged ROInet.zip. When set, the network files are loaded from there instead of being downloaded, which is required inside the pipeline where every task otherwise re-fetches ~105 MB from osf.io.

parameters.name: verify
parameters.description: Round-trip the emitted processing.json and quality_control.json through the core v2 schema objects after writing.
parameters.help_text: Round-trip the emitted processing.json and quality_control.json through the core v2 schema objects after writing.
